text: Thornbury Press has bought the rights to The Glass Cartographer, according to documents shown to this reporter and a brief call with the house’s acquisitions editor on Tuesday. The deal, struck late Monday for an undisclosed sum, covers print and digital publication in Edrin and two overseas markets, with a first edition planned for spring 2027. I was told the novel will be edited by Mara Venn, who said the manuscript “has the kind of patient, strange energy we look for.” At Baywater’s North Quay Bookshop, manager Leon Trask said he had already fielded three customer questions about the title before noon. The author, Ilya Brant, did not immediately return a message.
